svg.title: BeagleBoard rev C (TI OMAP3530), component side
svg.desc: Orthographic top view of the original 78.7 × 76.2 mm BeagleBoard. Copper, solder mask, silkscreen, drills and part positions are converted from the rev C design files by Gerald Coley of BeagleBoard.org (CC BY-SA 3.0); the parts, colours and finish are redrawn from the author’s photographs of a rev C board. Legends are outlines; LEDs are drawn unlit.
